subject: JGR crashes on loading TCL/TK Mac Lion

messages.author: ac98e5aec3e35fd5
messages.subject: JGR crashes on loading TCL/TK Mac Lion
parts:
I installed yesterday on my laptop and everything went great.

Went to install on my work desktop (iMac Lion). I followed http://www.deducer.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php?n=Main.MacOSXInstallation.

When I launch- the JGR console starts but gets stuck and crashes on the "loading the TCL/TK interface". It crashes- then I get a JGR quit unexpectedly while using the tcltk.so plug-in. 

I tried to delete all the R , JGR etc on my Mac and start over with a new download. I also tried the launch from the 32 and 64 bit. They both crash with the same message.

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: JGR crashes on loading TCL/TK Mac Lion
parts:
JGR does not require tcl/tk, and should not be calling it on loading.
One reason this could happen is if your Rprofile.site has some custom
code in it, but that should not be a default behavior. You can try to
install tcl/tk on your system and see if that solves the issue.

http://cran.r-project.org/bin/macosx/tools/

ian
